description: The halted turn of a factory run that posted its question round (#5785, ADR 0286 decisions 2 and 11). runner_frames are the ACI frames the runner emits on the real bundled CLI when the model calls ask_questions, the route answers 200, and the platform then ends the turn before the model is asked again; pinned by runner/tests/test_question_halt_real_cli.py without version, token counts or call arguments. request_view is the API's internal request view for that request while it runs, pinned by apps/api/tests/test_factory_question_ending.py. worker_finish is what the worker reports when it replays both, pinned by apps/worker/tests/kernel/test_question_halt_handoff.py, and the API settles it completed questions_asked.
